name: Inverse Manipulation (Inversion)
definition: An iterative method to optimize generation conditions (shape code zs, appearance code za, camera v) to inversely project an input image Ir to the generation manifold, following the EM algorithm.
summary: Inverse Manipulation is an iterative EM-style optimization that inversely projects images onto a NeRF manifold to find disentangled latent codes, enabling precise text-driven editing unlike direct retrieval.
